// diagnostic

E0120

`name` was not moved here, so it cannot fill this owning destination

What

`name` was not moved here, so it cannot fill this owning destination

Why

Read access does not transfer ownership; cloneable values copy automatically at ordinary owning destinations, but this value needs an explicit ownership decision

Fix

Write `name.copy()` for an owning copy, declare the parameter `name: &&T` when it should take ownership, or return borrowed data as `-> View<T> from name` with a view derived from `name`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0120: Tests/UI/Closures/returned_lambda_cannot_write_a_lent_parameter.stderr.

Error [jet.ReadOnlyValueNotOwned]: `values` was not moved here, so a returned lambda cannot write it
  --> Tests/UI/Closures/returned_lambda_cannot_write_a_lent_parameter.jet:1:36
    |
  1 | grow: fn(values: &[Int]) -> fn() { fn() { values.push(1) } }
    |                                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `values` is lent for writing only until this call returns, and the lambda it returns runs after that
 Fix: Make the parameter owned (`values: &&[Int]`) and return the result, or write `values` inside this call
